name: Q6 Tenant Hierarchy and Visibility Semantics

h0.content: Q6 tenant visibility semantics — who can see/act-on whose data across owner -> subdivision -> worker (ADR-0026 diagram 5 of 5, resolves Q6)

n1.content: current_tenancy_baseline: Client session verified via verifyAppwriteSession(); resolveTenant() resolves flat tenant_id (= Appwrite teamId, ADR-0025 baseline verified in packages/tenancy/src/index.ts:58)

n2.content: query_request_arrives: User query arrives (e.g. fetch task list, micro-ADRs, audit logs, worker status, billing usage) with authenticated user context

n3.content: which tenancy hierarchy architecture is selected (ADR-0026 Q6 decision fork)?

n4.content: model_a_materialized_path: Model A Architecture: Single Appwrite Team (tenant_id). Subdivisions structured via materialized string path (e.g. org_path='/root/workshop-1/brigade-a/'). ScopedWorkItemRepository binds orgPathPrefix at construction

n5.content: model_b_nested_subtenants: Model B Architecture: Each subdivision is a distinct Appwrite Team and separate D1 tenant_id with parent_tenant_id links (e.g. tenant_root -> tenant_subdiv_1 -> tenant_brigade_a). Hard Appwrite kernel-level boundary per team

n6.content: Model A caller role / tree level: root owner or subdivision lead/worker?

n7.content: model_a_owner_visibility: [ALLOWED] Project Owner (org_path='/'): queries prefix '/' -> sees ALL subdivisions, all brigade task queues, all Micro-ADRs, and aggregate tenant billing metrics. [FORBIDDEN] Cannot access data belonging to any OTHER tenant_id (hard ADR-0025 boundary across organizations).

n8.content: Model A caller is subdivision lead (intermediate) or frontline worker (leaf)?

n9.content: model_a_lead_visibility: [ALLOWED] Subdivision Lead (e.g. org_path='/workshop-1/'): queries prefix '/workshop-1/' -> sees/acts on all subordinate brigades and workers (/workshop-1/*), reviews pending Micro-ADRs. [FORBIDDEN] CANNOT query peer subdivisions (e.g. '/workshop-2/' returns 0 rows) or root tenant-level data outside own prefix.

n10.content: model_a_worker_visibility: [ALLOWED] Frontline Worker (e.g. org_path='/workshop-1/brigade-a/worker-3'): queries own leaf path -> receives only assigned tasks (WHERE assigned_user_id = worker_id) & local drafts. [FORBIDDEN] CANNOT query peer worker private drafts or cross-brigade task queues (data-minimization).

n11.content: model_a_semantics_summary: Model A Semantics: Soft boundary inside organization (repository constructor binds orgPathPrefix, fast SQL LIKE prefix queries). Hard isolation across distinct tenant_ids. Simple single-team billing.

n12.content: visibility_decision_synthesis: Comparative Decision Synthesis: Model A aligns with mass-user simplicity and unified single-team billing; Model B offers cryptographic isolation between subdivisions at the expense of complex cross-tenant federation.

n13.content: Model B caller role / tree level: root owner or subdivision lead/worker?

n14.content: model_b_owner_visibility: [ALLOWED] Root Owner (in tenant_root): requires elevated multi-tenant traversal API / token impersonation to query across child tenant_ids (tenant_subdiv_1, tenant_subdiv_2). [FORBIDDEN] Cannot run simple single SQL joins across sub-tenants; requires federated scatter-gather queries across database boundaries.

n15.content: Model B caller is subdivision lead or frontline worker?

n16.content: model_b_lead_visibility: [ALLOWED] Subdivision Lead (in tenant_subdiv_1): Appwrite session token scoped to tenant_subdiv_1. Full access to all items within that sub-tenant team. [FORBIDDEN] Hard kernel isolation: IMPOSSIBLE to query peer tenant (tenant_subdiv_2) or parent (tenant_root) — Appwrite rejects token at gateway.

n17.content: model_b_worker_visibility: [ALLOWED] Frontline Worker (in tenant_subdiv_1): token restricted to sub-tenant team; queries filtered to own assigned tasks. [FORBIDDEN] Absolute cryptographic & token-level isolation from all other sub-tenants.

n18.content: model_b_semantics_summary: Model B Semantics: Hardest isolation guarantee (ADR-0025 boundary per subdivision). High complexity: recursive billing aggregation across N Appwrite teams, difficult cross-subdivision worker transfers.

end.content: Decision gate: Choice between Model A and Model B remains open for Q. Packet P1 will implement the corresponding repository isolation test suite (prefix isolation vs multi-tenant delegation) once Q rules.

meta.description: Diagram 5 of ADR-0026's detailing list (resolving Q6 tenant visibility). Details the visibility semantics (who can query/act on whose data) across owner -> subdivision -> worker under both architectural options (Model A: materialized org_path in single Appwrite team vs Model B: nested sub-tenant Appwrite teams) without pre-empting Q's decision.

model_a_materialized_path.owner: Allowed: All subtrees (/root/*), tenant-wide tasks, all micro-ADRs, total billing. Forbidden: Any other tenant_id.
model_a_materialized_path.subdivision_lead: Allowed: Own subtree (/root/subdivA/*), brigade tasks, pending micro-ADRs. Forbidden: Peer subtrees (/root/subdivB/*), root tenant data.
model_a_materialized_path.worker: Allowed: Own assigned tasks, own draft notes. Forbidden: Peer workers' private drafts, cross-brigade tasks.

model_b_nested_subtenants.owner: Allowed: Child sub-tenants via elevated traversal API / impersonation tokens. Forbidden: Direct SQL joins across sub-tenants.
model_b_nested_subtenants.subdivision_lead: Allowed: Own sub-tenant team items. Forbidden: Peer sub-tenants (tenant_subdivB) or parent tenant (token gateway rejection).
model_b_nested_subtenants.worker: Allowed: Own assigned tasks within sub-tenant. Forbidden: All other sub-tenant teams.
